reasoning: Recent New York coverage found no current Senate general-election polling, but it did surface multiple August 2026 polls for the governor’s race showing Kathy Hochul ahead by margins ranging from 8 to 17 points. Because those are not the Senate or presidential race, they are only other-context signals and do not establish a current Senate/presidential margin; the statewide Cook PVI remains strongly Democratic at D+23.
